_meta.title: Titan Rulebook — canonical machine-readable line registry
_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every licensed line. The SCANNER (pine/python) reads the 'scanner' fields to detect+display; the EXECUTION/APP (Titan Ops) reads 'execution','sizing','risk' to enforce at entry and manage. Human cards live in reports/PLAYBOOK.md; this file is what code consumes.
_meta.smart: Each rule is Specific (exact condition), Measurable (numeric thresholds + receipts), Achievable (backtest-validated), Relevant (licensed only), Time-bound (every exit has a clock: 50% target OR 21 DTE).

component_owners.scanner: detect entry trigger + gate state + habitat; DISPLAY only, no orders. Fields: market, entry, gate, habitat.
component_owners.execution: signal->order timing (D+1 9:30), structure, exits. Fields: structure, exits, entry_basis.
component_owners.risk: cluster tail-budget check BEFORE any add. Fields: cluster, references _CLUSTERS in worst-loss-reference.json.
component_owners.journal: record + grade adherence. Owned by Titan Ops app, not this file.

global.exit_default: take_profit_50 OR manage_21dte; NO price stops; NO trend-flip exit (curve-fit, killed OOS)
global.entry_basis: signal confirmed at day-D close; enter D+1 ~09:30 (validated D+1 basis)
global.note_risk_pct: Do NOT raise risk_pct. MAR peaks ~3% then falls; 2% is the disciplined setting.

sizing_engine._algo: n=floor(risk_pct*equity/stress_anchor); n=min(n,abs_ceil); room=cluster_budget_pct*equity - sum(open worst-case in cluster); n=min(n,floor(room/stress_anchor)); return max(0,n). Allocation (step3) can return 0 -> skip_reason=capacity.

MNG.note: stress anchor inflated ~4x over $45 historical for weather tail; revisit after live winter

cluster_budget_pct._note: CONFIRMED 2026-07-27: SEPARATE budget, NOT nested in the VIX equity allocation. Energy is 0.11-correlated to equities -> genuine diversification. Sim: adding energy improved book MAR 0.49->0.56 with maxDD UNCHANGED (12.7%). Equity book runs VIX-band throttle; energy runs its own tail cap; they do not interact (only raw buying-power is shared, and energy uses ~$1-2K = non-binding).

_governance_model.equity_cluster: VIX-band MARGIN throttle (25% calm..60% stress) — many correlated positions need a regime pedal
_governance_model.energy_cluster: TAIL-CAP only (worst-case <= 5% equity), regime-agnostic — small, fat-tailed, uncorrelated; no OVX allocation band needed
_governance_model.ovx_note: OVX is an ENTRY-QUALITY signal (high+STABILIZING = rich premium, safe to sell; high+RISING = kill zone), NOT an allocation throttle. CL call line currently validated UNGATED; whether an OVX rich+stabilizing gate IMPROVES it is UNTESTED (small future study).

allocation._purpose: Portfolio-level capital allocation. Governs HOW MUCH total capital is deployed and WHETHER a sized trade is admitted. Sits ABOVE per-line sizing_engine.
allocation.confirmed: 2026-07-21 (calm-band re-sweep); bands 25/50/60 win all metrics; $50K->$99.7K MAR 1.52 on modern book
allocation.buy_note: flat 15% for long-vol sleeve (straddles) + micro long calls; separate bucket from selling
allocation.sell_budget_meaning: MARGIN/BPR committed to short premium <= band% of equity. Applies to the EQUITY+FUTURES-PUT selling book (VIX is its regime).
allocation.energy_separate: ENERGY cluster (CL/NG calls) is NOT in the VIX sell budget — it has its own 5% TAIL cap (regime-agnostic). 0.11-corr to equities = separate, confirmed improves book MAR 0.49->0.56.
allocation.dedupe: EQUITY puts: 1 open per name + max 3 NEW equity entries/day (raised 2->3 on 2026-07-30: passed kill bar in signal-level sim (+14% profit, tot/DD 6.38->7.47, DD DOWN) AND canonical $-sim (MAR 2.71->2.74, DD flat) — burst-day signals are good signals in DIFFERENT names; cluster $-caps still govern concentration). 4/day tested even better (MAR 2.83) — held as candidate, not adopted. 21-day same-name loss cooldown applies on top (LOSS_COOLDOWN_RULE).
allocation.capacity: If a fully-sized trade does not fit the remaining band budget -> SKIP, skip_reason='capacity'. ~20% skip rate is BY DESIGN = implicit correlation filter (skips cluster during same-regime bursts = the most redundant trades). Never raise bands to force fills.
allocation.idle_cash: sweep idle collateral to T-bills (was the largest sleeve raw)

OPTIMAL_RULE_2026-07-29.finding: With dedupe + cluster tail caps in place, the VIX-MARGIN band is REDUNDANT on a $50K micro book. Sweep 2015-2026: tight 25% skips 424 good trades ($63.8K); loose/off makes more ($81K) at similar low DD because dedupe+cluster-caps+ENTRY-gate already control risk. Crash protection comes from the VIX 3-green ENTRY gate (never sell into expanding vol), NOT the allocation band.

add: equity-index cluster cap ~7% (only uncapped correlated group)
rule.avoid: flat-100% (no buffer for a grinding bear not in the 2015-26 sample)

OPTIMAL_RULE_2026-07-29.caveat: Absolute CAGR 2-4% is the CONSERVATIVE SUBSET (micro 1-lot, no name-gate/straddle/long-call/T-bill, no size-steps). Full book ~12% CAGR. Band RANKING is the takeaway, not dollars. In-sample crash = V-shaped 2020 only.

FULL_BOOK_RESULT_2026-07-29.note: 6.2% < old v2 12.2% because 2015 start (weak 2015-18) + conservative T-bills + cluster caps. Defensive fully-controlled version. Size-steps lift MAR 1.72->2.04.

FINAL_POLICY.L2_dedupe_equity: one open/name + max 2 new equity/day (the equity concentration control; a hard equity %-cap HURT in testing)
FINAL_POLICY.L4_margin_bands: SELL ~50% (not 25%=over-throttle micros, not 100%=no buffer); BUY 15% (straddles+long calls). Mostly vestigial once L2+L3 bind — keep as crisis buffer.

THE_BLUEPRINT_2026-07-29.philosophy: Capital protection FIRST. Never 100% deployed (structural via cluster caps). Toyota (endurance) over Ferrari.

BUYING_debit.note: straddles HEDGE the sell book (win in crashes)

BALLAST.T_bills: the rest ~60-70% idle collateral = capital protection + yield

THE_BLUEPRINT_2026-07-29.structural: per-cluster tail caps (7/5/5) + 12% total cap MATHEMATICALLY prevent >15% short-premium tail. Cannot deploy 100% to selling - trade rejected skip:capacity first.
THE_BLUEPRINT_2026-07-29.proof: full-book sim: doubles $50K->$100K over 11yr at 3% maxDD, MAR 2.04.
THE_BLUEPRINT_2026-07-29.speed_option: 50/50 = double the selling tail budgets (eqidx 14/energy 8/metals 8, ~30% total) -> ~2x return AND drawdown. NOT recommended in $50K build phase; protection first.
THE_BLUEPRINT_2026-07-29.sector_dedupe: TESTED 2026-07-29: sector-diverse dedupe = IDENTICAL to plain (max-2/day already prevents same-sector-same-day pairs). NOT adopted - inert complexity.

DEPLOYMENT_FRONTIER_2026-07-29.finding: 25% BPR to selling is OPTIMAL, not conservative. Frontier (full book, size-steps): Toyota ~25% BPR = $99.9K/6.2%CAGR/3.0%DD/MAR2.04; Balanced ~40% = $96.2K/5.9%/4.8%/1.22; Aggressive ~55% = $100.9K/6.3%/7.1%/0.88. Deploying 25%->55% BPR: SAME return, 2.4x drawdown.
DEPLOYMENT_FRONTIER_2026-07-29.why: Book is limited by SIGNAL QUALITY not capital. First ~25% BPR captures all the edge (best/most-diversified trades). Extra deployment drags in marginal, correlated, redundant trades = variance without edge.
DEPLOYMENT_FRONTIER_2026-07-29.cash_is_not_waste: 60% T-bills = (1) margin buffer vs vol-spike liquidation, (2) dry powder to deploy MORE when VIX high, (3) yield. It's the ballast that gives the 3% DD.
DEPLOYMENT_FRONTIER_2026-07-29.kills_speed_tradeoff: NO speed/endurance tradeoff exists. Toyota (25%) = same return as Aggressive (55%) at <half the DD. The '50/50 speed option' documented earlier is SUPERSEDED - there is no speed to buy by deploying more.
DEPLOYMENT_FRONTIER_2026-07-29.FINAL: SELLING ~25% BPR (eqidx 7 + energy 5 + metals 5 tail) · BUYING ~15% BPR (straddle 10 + longcall 5) · T-BILLS ~60%. Do NOT deploy more - strictly worse.

CLUSTER_BASIS_LAW.law: Cluster/total tail budgets (EQIDX 7% / ENERGY 5% / METALS 5% / TOTAL 12% of equity) are accounted in P95-ANCHOR dollars. Per-trade sizing STAYS on worst-case anchors: qty = clamp(floor(0.02*E/worst_anchor), 1, cap). Two bases, two jobs: worst-anchor sizes the single trade so the once-per-decade bomb costs ~2%; p95 prices the bucket at what a correlated bad DAY actually costs.
CLUSTER_BASIS_LAW.why: Worst-basis buckets jam a small account (2 MES = $3,138 anchors ~ fills the whole EQIDX room at $44K; book admits 445 vs 815 trades, CAGR 5.1% vs 8.4%). The worst case is already absorbed one layer down (per-trade worst-anchor sizing) and one layer up (25% BPR fence + VIX 3-green entry gate). Pricing the bucket at worst-case double-counts the same catastrophe three times.
CLUSTER_BASIS_LAW.receipts: Ledger audit 2026-08-21, docs/ledgers/ (every trade CSV'd): p95 12% bank = $44K->$111,349, 8.4% CAGR, 6.0% DD, 815 trades, 75% win (real year-varying T-bill rates). Roof is signal-limited, not capital-limited: room pressed on 8 days out of 2,996; 50% roof adds 9 net trades (+$1,200/11.5yr); caps 25/50/60 byte-identical on p95.
CLUSTER_BASIS_LAW.capacity_tiebreak_convention: On a day capacity binds (~8 days/decade), admit signals ranked by highest IV-RV spread, then alphabetical. Deterministic convention, NOT a tested edge (total surface ~$1.2K/decade - too small to ever study).

SGOV_COLLATERAL_RULE.rule: SGOV/T-bill ETF is COLLATERAL + yield, NOT a tracked position. Never blocked by dedupe/cluster/band rules; never counts against any allocation budget.
SGOV_COLLATERAL_RULE.mechanics: VERIFIED (tastytrade order screen 2026-07-29): buying 100 SGOV (~$10,066) reduces STOCK BP $5,033 (50% Reg-T initial) and OPTION BP ~$2,516 (25%). For sell book the OPTION-BP 25% binds: ~75% of SGOV value stays available to sell against, +~4.5% yield. SGOV = efficient dual-use collateral.
SGOV_COLLATERAL_RULE.futures_caveat: MES/MCL/MNG options need CASH margin (futures side) - SGOV can't collateralize those. Keep cash for futures sleeves.
SGOV_COLLATERAL_RULE.example_42k: ~300 sh SGOV (~$30K) + ~$12K cash (futures margin+buffer). Verify exact BP on platform (Reg-T vs PM differs).
SGOV_COLLATERAL_RULE.yield_note: YIELD FLOATS with Fed short rate minus 0.09% ER — never treat as constant. Was ~4.5% mid-2026 planning; VERIFIED live 2026-08-17: \$30.68 July distribution on 100sh = ~3.65% annualized. Sensitivity: each -1pt on SGOV = ~-0.6pt on income-book CAGR (idle ~60%); plans robust, update RF in sims when it drifts >0.5pt.
SGOV_COLLATERAL_RULE.allocation_target: TARGET: SGOV = 60-75% of NLV (e.g., \$25-30K at \$44K); raw CASH = the MINIMUM the futures sleeves need (~\$8-12K — MES/MCL/MNG margins are cash-only, SGOV cannot collateralize futures). Each \$10K SGOV consumes ~25% of ITS OWN value (~\$2.5K) as BPR — NOT 25% of account BP. SGOV earns on its FULL value even while collateralizing short premium (double-employment verified on TJ's order screen). Cash-drag receipt 2026-08-21: 38% idle cash costs ~0.6%/yr; each 10% shifted cash->SGOV = ~+0.35%/yr at current rates.

allocation.IDLE_IS_NORMAL: Energy & metals fire ~1-4 trades/yr each; their 5% budgets sit EMPTY most of the time. Correct + expected. Empty cluster != under-deployed. Never loosen to fill idle budgets.

THETA_INVARIANT.rule: aggregate daily theta of SHORT book <= 0.10% of net_liq
THETA_INVARIANT.action_on_breach: alarm/log only — do NOT block trades; a breach means a sizing or cluster cap upstream has failed; investigate
THETA_INVARIANT.rationale: theta is a byproduct of position count x size, both already bounded by 2% sizing + cluster caps (7/5/5, total 12%) + dedupe. Book historical max = 0.06%. As a hard skip below the operating range it costs return with no drawdown benefit (0.03% -> MAR 2.04->1.85, maxDD unchanged); above it (>=0.10%) it never binds. Correct form is alarm-only.
THETA_INVARIANT.verified: run_theta_cap_sim.py 2026-07-30 (theta via credit proxy; live app should re-verify with real chain theta)

LOSS_COOLDOWN_RULE.law: After a booked LOSS in a name/line: NO new entry in that same name for 21 calendar days from the losing exit. After a WIN: next signal immediately tradeable. Name-local — other names never blocked.

receipts.kill_bar: pre-registered: OOS <=21d cohort avg<0 or >=$75/tr worse than after-win — PASSED both datasets; OOS effect LARGER than in-sample

LOSS_COOLDOWN_RULE.mechanism: a booked loss = receipt that the NAME's storm is live; name-storms outlive one option cycle (per-name echo of the slope light / never-sell-into-rising-vol law)
LOSS_COOLDOWN_RULE.basis_note: tested entry-to-entry gap; law uses exit-to-entry (stricter, safe direction)
LOSS_COOLDOWN_RULE.scanner_enforcement: pine tj_scanner.pine: set cdRoot=<losing symbol> + cdLossExit=<losing exit date> after any loss; ACTION row shows '🧊 COOLDOWN — Nd left', sell-put alerts suppressed, name-local. Guarded by 5 pine-regression laws (cooldown-*).
LOSS_COOLDOWN_RULE.win_side: ANY profitable exit clears the name IMMEDIATELY — win speed irrelevant (fast <=7d 50%-hit: next trade 87% win +$110 n=194; re-entry within 10d of a fast win = BEST cohort 95% +$148 n=21).
